Class WindowView

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.slotkit.api.window.WindowView
public final class WindowView extends Object
The window's view of one open menu, which mints typed WindowHandles. A handle is a value addressing one thing; the view is how you get one for "this slot on the screen in front of me".

What it does

Mints handles by address. slot(int) turns a vanilla menu index into a slot handle (through VanillaAddressing); slot(ModeScope, Address) wraps one a consumer already holds, checking the KindTag so a panel address (still parsed from text 6.x saved) can't pass as a slot.

Setting and reading behavior on a handle goes straight to the engine (WindowEngine, by address) and needs no live resolution. So it works with the client tier on any server, and with SlotKit on the server for server-tier behavior too.
